$comment: Rationale manifest for every check recorded as UNKNOWN (never auto-PASS). Two flavors: gap_documented = behavior demonstrated and recorded, but the written protocol does not require the stronger property (or the enforcing layer is undelivered); blocked = cannot be executed because the enforcing component was not delivered in the S0 snapshot. freeze_blocking=true marks UNKNOWNs the Commander has ruled must be dispositioned before G1 Freeze (not deferrable). kind=spec_asserted marks Commander-ruled normative assertions (test/16): the gate FAILs while the rule is missing; these are never UNKNOWN. Freeze blocker status is EVIDENCE-DRIVEN (build-report): a blocker is DISPOSITIONED only when its normative assertion(s) all PASS.

PKG-ENTRY-01.rationale: Reconciliation-18: the original blocker (Builder A editing the live tree during verification) is CLOSED — every capture is pinned at a pushed SHA from the git object database (mode=git-sha, capture.json). The barrel/entry-point import remains unevaluated because packaging is outside S0 gate scope; re-opens with S1 packaging.
PKG-ENTRY-01.blocked_by: packaging layer out of S0 scope

C-07-04.rationale: Duplicate artifact hashes/run ids accepted while a bundle is OPEN; the delivered superRefine only guards SEALED.

C-07-07.rationale: Duplicate keys in raw JSON text collapse last-wins at JS parse time before canonicalization; two byte-different evidence texts can share one hash.

C-08-05.rationale: Criterion.threshold is open-ended JSON by design; arbitrary nested semantics are representable inside a frozen criterion.

C-08-06.rationale: Reconciliation-18: the Milestone half is CLOSED — MilestoneV1 is delivered on the frozen wire (TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e) and its strict alias/unknown-field rejection is asserted by S-MS-WIRE-01. Plan/ExecutionRun/CapabilityGrant/ContributionEdge/DisputeCase remain outside the delivered G1 scope.

C-09-09.rationale: payload_hash is format-checked only; the (bytes, hash) binding is enforced by CAS-side recomputation outside the delivered layer.

C-10-08.rationale: SUPERSEDED PREMISE (remediation-18, PR #5 review): MilestoneV1 IS delivered on the frozen wire (TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e) and content immutability is enforced by the digest (every required field incl. criterion_ids feeds content_hash — asserted by S-MS-WIRE / S-MS-HASH). Only the lifecycle MUTATION machinery (revision bump / acceptance transition) remains undelivered; that is S1 scope.

C-12-06.rationale: A decision may reference an OPEN (unsealed) bundle; nothing in the delivered layer binds decision validity to bundle state.

C-12-07.rationale: Same bundle_id with a different artifact set is representable; no uniqueness/append-only constraint exists in the schema layer.

C-13-12.rationale: Run manifest / grant / edge NodeRef / dispute reference validation cannot be tested: objects absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-14-02.rationale: decision.intent_hash can be fabricated; no delivered API binds a decision to an existing Intent object.
C-14-02.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-18 (PR #3 round 5): cross-object referential existence is DEFERRED to S1 — not a G1 blocker. Schema-level acceptance of dangling refs remains recorded as UNKNOWN.

C-14-03.rationale: decision.evidence_root need not equal merkleRoot(bundle.artifact_hashes); the contradiction is representable.
C-14-03.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-18 (PR #3 round 5): cross-object referential existence is DEFERRED to S1 — not a G1 blocker. Schema-level acceptance of dangling refs remains recorded as UNKNOWN.

C-14-05.rationale: decision.milestone_id / bundle.milestone_id can dangle; no schema-layer existence check exists (the Milestone object itself IS delivered on the frozen wire — remediation-18 corrected the stale 'not delivered' premise). Existence enforcement is deferred with the other cross-object referential checks.
C-14-05.commander_ruling: Commander ruling 2026-09-18 (PR #3 round 5): cross-object referential existence is DEFERRED to S1 — not a G1 blocker. Schema-level acceptance of dangling refs remains recorded as UNKNOWN.

C-14-08.rationale: verification/settlement policy refs are content-addressed but no policy object schema ships to bind them.

C-14-09.rationale: ContributionEdge.evidence_ref existence unenforceable: Edge object absent from the delivered S0 snapshot.

C-14-10.rationale: DisputeCase.challenged_decision existence unenforceable: DisputeCase object absent.

C-14-11.rationale: ExecutionRun.grants existence/scope unenforceable: Run/Grant objects absent.

C-15-05.rationale: Delivered EvidenceBundleState has 2 of the 7 states documented in arch doc §7; VERIFYING/VALID/INVALID/INSUFFICIENT/CHALLENGED are absent.

C-15-06.rationale: Reconciliation-18: the Milestone OBJECT is delivered on the frozen wire; only the lifecycle machinery (state enum + transition engine, arch doc §7) is undelivered — S1 scope, same deferral class as C-10-08.

C-15-07.rationale: Settlement state machine (arch doc §7) not delivered; SettlementInstruction has no state field in S0.

C-15-08.rationale: Intent state machine (arch doc §7) not delivered.

C-15-09.rationale: G0 gate 'illegal transitions 100% blocked' cannot be evaluated: no state-machine code exists (@intent/intent-core absent).

S-R9.rationale: R9 PROOF TARGET BINDING: proof_binding must be computed over intent_hash, milestone_id, bundle_id, milestone_revision, evidence_root and policy_hash. [S-R9] FAILs any SUT whose binding does not separate both proof targets.
S-R9.commander_ruling: Commander ruling R9 (PROOF TARGET BINDING), 2026-09-17: V1 proof_binding MUST bind at least intent_hash + milestone_id + milestone_revision + evidence_root + policy_hash. A proof must prove the result belongs to THIS specific milestone. Not deferrable to S1.

S-SUBJ.rationale: SubjectRef rejects '@' (OQ-5): no lookalike principal ids.
S-SUBJ.commander_ruling: Commander OQ-5 disposition, 2026-09-17/18: remove '@' from SubjectRef id charset in V1.

S-UUID.rationale: UUID canonical form is lowercase hyphenated text, version-agnostic; uppercase and non-UUID text must be rejected.

S-RT.rationale: R10 SEALED ROUND-TRIP: all five first-class hashable objects (IntentContract, EvidenceArtifact, EvidenceBundle, VerificationDecision, SettlementInstruction) must seal -> JSON text round-trip -> re-seal idempotently and reject a wrong declared content_hash.
S-RT.commander_ruling: Commander R-series, 2026-09-18: sealed round-trip not holding -> FAIL.

S-ASSET.rationale: One SettlementInstruction carries exactly one asset; mixed-asset outputs must be rejected.
S-ASSET.commander_ruling: Commander R-series, 2026-09-18: multiple assets in one Settlement -> FAIL.

S-SCALE.rationale: Output amount scale (decimal places) must not exceed the referenced asset's decimals.
S-SCALE.commander_ruling: Commander R-series, 2026-09-18: amount scale beyond asset.decimals -> FAIL.

S-BUDGET.rationale: Budget execution_cap must not exceed total.
S-BUDGET.commander_ruling: Commander R-series, 2026-09-18: budget cap > total -> FAIL.

S-SURR.rationale: IPC-JSON-1 rejects lone surrogates: strings must be Unicode scalar text.
S-SURR.commander_ruling: Commander R-series, 2026-09-18: lone surrogate entering IPC-JSON-1 -> FAIL.

S-UNIQ.rationale: criterion_id and constraint_id are unique within their Intent.
S-UNIQ.commander_ruling: Commander R-series + PR #3 round 5: ID uniqueness is executable spec; old GAP blocker deduplicated into this assertion.

S-MERKLE.rationale: A SEALED bundle is rejected unless its merkle_root equals the recomputed root of its artifact set.
S-MERKLE.commander_ruling: Commander R-series + PR #3 round 5: SEALED merkle enforcement is executable spec.

S-DEC.rationale: Amounts are canonical Decimal V1 minimal form: '150'/'15.5' accepted; '1.10'/'0.00'/'-0'/'150.0' rejected.
S-DEC.commander_ruling: Commander R-series + PR #3 round 5: canonical decimal is executable spec.

S-SUM.rationale: total_amount equals the exact (BigInt) sum of outputs.amount.
S-SUM.commander_ruling: Commander R-series + PR #3 round 5: settlement sum invariant is executable spec.

S-KEYNFC.rationale: IPC-JSON-1 R3: object keys must ALREADY be in Normalization Form C; non-NFC keys are rejected, never silently normalized (silent normalization created duplicate-key ambiguity).
S-KEYNFC.commander_ruling: Commander OQ-1 / IPC-JSON-1 freeze, 2026-09-18: canonical profile named IPC-JSON-1; keys must already be NFC.

S-MS-WIRE.rationale: MilestoneV1 EXACT WIRE (B-TC1): exported as MilestoneSchema under its EXACT frozen name; field-name set EXACTLY {schema_version, milestone_id, intent_hash, milestone_revision, criterion_ids, verification_policy_hash, settlement_policy_hash, allocation, content_hash?, signature?}; literal 'milestone.v1'; alias/unknown fields rejected; revision >= 1; criterion_ids non-empty and unique; allocation scale <= asset.decimals.
S-MS-WIRE.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): exact wire contracts are normative for G1; semantic aliases are not conforming; Milestone identity is (intent_hash, milestone_id, milestone_revision).

S-MS-HASH.rationale: MilestoneV1 DIGEST RULES (B-TC1): every required field feeds content_hash; criterion_ids array order is canonical (swapping changes the digest); domain pinned byte-exactly to intent-protocol/v1/milestone over milestone.v1 against the independent reference; seal -> JSON round-trip -> re-seal idempotent; wrong declared hash rejected.
S-MS-HASH.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): changing any required field changes the object digest.

S-RCPT-WIRE.rationale: OutcomeReceiptV1 EXACT WIRE (B-TC2): exported as OutcomeReceiptSchema under its EXACT frozen name (no ReceiptSchema fallback); field-name set EXACTLY {schema_version, receipt_id, intent_hash, milestone_id, milestone_revision, evidence_root, verification_policy_hash, decision_hashes, accepted_result, issued_at, content_hash?, signature?}; literals 'outcome-receipt.v1' and 'ACCEPTED'; alias/unknown fields rejected.
S-RCPT-WIRE.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): receipt wire/hash object and deterministic bindings are frozen in G1; formation logic is S1.

S-RCPT-SET.rationale: OutcomeReceiptV1 DECISION SET RULES (B-TC2): decision_hashes must be non-empty, unique, and strictly lexicographically ascending; empty, duplicate, or descending sets are rejected.
S-RCPT-SET.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): duplicates or non-sorted decision_hashes are invalid; the set is the deterministic accepted-decision commitment.

S-RCPT-HASH.rationale: OutcomeReceiptV1 DIGEST RULES (B-TC2): every required field feeds content_hash; domain pinned byte-exactly to intent-protocol/v1/outcome-receipt over outcome-receipt.v1 against the independent reference; seal -> JSON round-trip -> re-seal idempotent; wrong declared hash rejected.
S-RCPT-HASH.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): changing any required field changes the object digest.

S-GATE-AUTH.rationale: SETTLEMENT IS RECEIPT-GATED (B-TC3): SettlementInstructionV1 field set EXACTLY {schema_version, settlement_id, escrow_ref, outcome_receipt_hash, nonce, outputs, total_amount, expires_at?, content_hash?}; the authority fields decision_id and proof_binding are FORBIDDEN and unrepresentable; a settlement without outcome_receipt_hash is rejected; the superseded decision-gated wire must NOT parse; one-asset/scale/exact-sum rules hold on the receipt-gated wire.
S-GATE-AUTH.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): settlement is authorized only from an accepted OutcomeReceipt; a raw VerificationDecision / proof_binding is never settlement authority.

S-SETTLEMENT-KEY.rationale: SETTLEMENT KEY FROZEN BYTE PROTOCOL (B-TC4): settlement_key = SHA256("intent-protocol/v1/settlement-key" || 0x00 || outcome_receipt_hash[32] || UTF8(escrow_ref) || 0x00 || nonce_u64be[8]). Three independent implementations must agree byte-exactly: the TS oracle (src/reference/hash.ts), the Python KAT (scripts/kat-settlement-key.py via vectors/settlement-key-vector.json, whose expected was computed by Python first), and the SUT. A SUT computing the superseded proof_binding-keyed, domain-less preimage FAILS.
S-SETTLEMENT-KEY.commander_ruling: Commander freeze, docs/TRUST-CHAIN.md @ e28a22e (2026-09-18): settlement idempotency key binds the receipt, with explicit 0x00 terminator before the fixed-width u64be nonce; same three-way discipline as R9.
